name: Pembrolizumab + Carboplatin/Paclitaxel then Pembrolizumab + AC (KEYNOTE-522), then Adjuvant Pembrolizumab
histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC))

biomarkers.note: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC): ER-negative, PR-negative, HER2-negative (subtype #3). Per the guideline, this preoperative-plus-adjuvant KEYNOTE-522 regimen applies to stage II to III TNBC regardless of PD-L1 status (PD-L1 is NOT required, unlike the metastatic pembrolizumab-plus-chemotherapy indication which requires PD-L1 CPS at least 10). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, BINV-M.

lineOfTherapy: preoperative (neoadjuvant) chemoimmunotherapy followed by adjuvant pembrolizumab for stage II to III triple-negative breast cancer; not line-scoped

eligibilityCriteria.locator: v6.2026, BINV-M 2 of 10 (HR-Negative/HER2-Negative, stage II to III preoperative)
v6.2026, BINV-M 2 of 10; dosing BINV-M 5 of 10 reference 5 (Schmid, KEYNOTE-522)

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab

provenance.locator: BINV-M 5 of 10 (Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV or 2 mg/kg Day 1)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10 (KEYNOTE-522). Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV (or 2 mg/kg) on day 1, every 21 days, given in BOTH neoadjuvant phases (cycles 1 to 4 with carboplatin/paclitaxel, then cycles 5 to 8 with doxorubicin/cyclophosphamide) AND adjuvantly for 9 cycles after surgery. Alternative (footnote o): pembrolizumab 400 mg IV or 4 mg/kg every 42 days.

drugs.name: PACLitaxel

provenance.locator: BINV-M 5 of 10 (Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV Days 1, 8, and 15)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10. PACLitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8, and 15. Neoadjuvant phase 1 only (cycles 1 to 4). Tall-man per ISMP.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10. CARBOplatin AUC 5 IV on day 1 (target AUC). Neoadjuvant phase 1 only (cycles 1 to 4). Source-stated alternative: CARBOplatin AUC 1.5 IV on days 1, 8, and 15. Tall-man per ISMP.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin

provenance.locator: BINV-M 5 of 10 (Doxorubicin 60 mg/m2 IV Day 1 or Epirubicin 90 mg/m2 IV Day 1)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10. DOXOrubicin 60 mg/m2 IV on day 1 (or Epirubicin 90 mg/m2 IV day 1). Neoadjuvant phase 2 only (cycles 5 to 8). Tall-man per ISMP. Cumulative lifetime cap is the conventional anthracycline ceiling (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2), not a dose from the breast table.

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10. Cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2 IV on day 1. Neoadjuvant phase 2 only (cycles 5 to 8).

regimen.cycles: Neoadjuvant: 8 cycles every 21 days - cycles 1 to 4 = pembrolizumab + carboplatin + paclitaxel; cycles 5 to 8 = pembrolizumab + doxorubicin (or epirubicin) + cyclophosphamide. Followed by surgery, then adjuvant pembrolizumab 200 mg every 21 days for 9 cycles (KEYNOTE-522). All chemotherapy cycles are with myeloid growth factor support.

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling (phase 1).

supportiveCare: G-CSF / myeloid growth factor support: all chemotherapy cycles are given with myeloid growth factor support per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M dosing footnote n.
Immune-related adverse event monitoring for pembrolizumab (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary, colitis, endocrinopathies).
Antiemetics: anthracycline/cyclophosphamide phase is high emetic risk; carboplatin/paclitaxel phase moderate; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.

monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated) during pembrolizumab

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: DeVita establishes pembrolizumab as a PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor and TNBC as a distinct breast subtype; the KEYNOTE-522 per-cycle regimen dosing is taken from the guideline layer

guideline.locator: Dosing: Preoperative/Adjuvant Therapy Regimens, HER2-Negative, Carboplatin/Paclitaxel + Pembrolizumab (preoperative) followed by Cyclophosphamide/Doxorubicin or Epirubicin + Pembrolizumab (preoperative) followed by Pembrolizumab (adjuvant), BINV-M 5 of 10 reference 5 (Schmid, KEYNOTE-522); setting BINV-M 2 of 10

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the KEYNOTE-522 triple-negative regimen (pembrolizumab plus carboplatin/paclitaxel, then pembrolizumab plus doxorubicin/cyclophosphamide, then adjuvant pembrolizumab). Serves subtype #3 (TNBC), histology-agnostic across invasive ductal (#1) and invasive lobular (#2) carcinoma. Every numeric dose is sourced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 5 of 10 (reference 5, Schmid KEYNOTE-522): pembrolizumab 200 mg (or 2 mg/kg) day 1; paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 days 1, 8, 15 with carboplatin AUC 5 day 1 (cycles 1 to 4); doxorubicin 60 mg/m2 (or epirubicin 90 mg/m2) plus cyclophosphamide 600 mg/m2 day 1 (cycles 5 to 8); then adjuvant pembrolizumab for 9 cycles, all every 21 days with growth factor support. Per the guideline this neoadjuvant regimen applies to stage II to III TNBC regardless of PD-L1 (PD-L1 not required). The full multi-phase sequence is recorded in regimen.cycles and per-drug notes. ISMP tall-man applied (PACLitaxel, CARBOplatin, DOXOrubicin). The DOXOrubicin cumulative lifetime cap (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2) is the conventional anthracycline ceiling, not a dose from the breast table. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
